Finance Controller and Finance Data Analyst

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification offers a total of 2 vacancies across two posts.

rows.qualification_required: MBA (Finance) / CA / PGDBM (Finance) / PGDBA (Finance) from a recognized University/Institute. Experience of at least 6 years in social sector, private or government sector in financial management operation, government accounting, funds flow management, utilization certificates and scheme-wise expenditure reporting in a government setup.

M.Com / MBA (Finance) / CA / ICWA from a recognized University or Institute. The applicant must have an experience of minimum 5 years in finance and accounts data management in social and private sector.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit varies by post on the last date of submitting application.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Salary
content_sections.text: While travelling on duty authorised in advance, the consultant will receive a fixed per diem allowance for boarding and lodging expenses as per NHSRC rules. The consultant shall not be entitled to any other benefits such as subsidy, compensation, or pension.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process includes evaluation of qualifications and experience, potential review by a Selection/Review Committee or Joint Selection Board, and a written test if included in the recruitment process, where the minimum qualifying mark will be 70%.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NHSRC
content_sections.text: Visit the official NHSRC website at http://nhsrcindia.org . Access the online application form for the respective post. Fill in the online application correctly with all required details. Attach the consultant's recent CV and evidence of last consultancy payment received. Submit the application in the prescribed online application format on or before 27 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications will be accepted in the prescribed online application format only. The last date for receiving applications is 27 October 2026. Initially, the contract will be up to 31 March 2027, subject to performance and requirement of the Division. The first three months of the contract will be on a probation basis. The consultant must be ready to travel extensively to State, District, Block, and village levels. All travels must be authorized in advance by the Director or DS (NHM-Finance). The consultancy can be terminated by either party by giving a notice of one month in writing. If the recruitment process includes a written test, a minimum qualifying mark will be 70%.

faq.question: Q1. What is the NHSRC recruitment 2026 about?
faq.answer: NHSRC has invited applications for Finance Controller and Finance Data Analyst posts on a contractual basis under the NHM Finance Division.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NHSRC recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies, with 1 position for Finance Controller and 1 position for Finance Data Analyst.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NHSRC posts?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving applications is 27 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification for Finance Controller?
faq.answer: Candidates need an MBA (Finance), CA, PGDBM (Finance), or PGDBA (Finance) from a recognized University or Institute, along with at least 6 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the essential qualification for Finance Data Analyst?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.Com, MBA (Finance), CA, or ICWA from a recognized University or Institute, along with a minimum of 5 years of experience in finance and accounts data management.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for NHSRC Finance Controller?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is up to 60 years as on the last date of submitting the application.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for NHSRC Finance Data Analyst?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is up to 50 years as on the last date of submitting the application.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for NHSRC recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for NHSRC recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates are requested to fill in the online application correctly via the NHSRC website at http://nhsrcindia.org.

faq.question: Q10. What is the salary range for these posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly remuneration ranges from Rs. 90,000 to Rs. 1,50,000 for Finance Controller and from Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 1,20,000 for Finance Data Analyst.
